        freq[ord(word[i]) - ord('a')] += 1

dominantCharFlag = False
dominantCharIdx = -1
for i in range(26):
    if freq[i] * 2 > pairCount:

        dominantCharIdx = i

if not dominantCharFlag:
    totalCostSum = 0
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if word[i] != word[n - i - 1]:
            totalCostSum += values[i] + values[n - i - 1]
        else:
            totalCostSum += max(values[i], values[n - i - 1])
    print(totalCostSum)
else:
    excessCount = freq[dominantCharIdx] - (pairCount - freq[dominantCharIdx])
    minValList = []
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1] and
            word[i] != chr(ord('a') + dominantCharIdx) and
            word[n - i - 1] != chr(ord('a') + dominantCharIdx)):
            minValList.append(min(values[i], values[n - i - 1]))
    minValList.sort()

    for i in range(n // 2):
        if word[i] == word[n - i - 1]:
            totalSum += max(values[i], values[n - i - 1])
        else:
            totalSum += values[i] + values[n - i - 1]
    for i in range(min(excessCount, len(minValList))):
        totalSum -= minValList[i]
    print(totalSum)
